title: Convergence of ∫_Ω Du_k(b) against C¹ fields with compact support in Ω
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, C ≥ 0, and let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ and u_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) all be C-Lipschitz on Ω, with u_k → u uniformly on Ω. Then for every C¹ field b : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ with compact support and tsupport b ⊆ Ω, ∫_Ω Du_k(w)(b(w)) dw → ∫_Ω Du(w)(b(w)) dw as k → ∞. Here Df(w) = fderiv ℝ f w (the Fréchet derivative where it exists, 0 otherwise), and integrals are Bochner integrals for Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ = Eucl n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (C : ℝ≥0) (u : Eucl n → ℝ) (ug : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → LipschitzOnWith C u Ω → (∀ k, LipschitzOnWith C (ug k) Ω) → TendstoUniformlyOn ug u atTop Ω → ∀ b : Eucl n → Eucl n, ContDiff ℝ 1 b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ Ω → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ (ug k) w (b w)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ u w (b w)))
